# ARIAgames

> Independent games made in Chile, built only for Apple Watch. Designed from scratch for the Digital Crown, haptics and the watch screen. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

## Games (App Store)
- [Kart Watch GP](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821168181): racing game for Apple Watch with original tracks, cups and racers, drift mini-turbos and nearby multiplayer.
- [Star Ace : Watch Shooter](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821445432): space rail shooter for Apple Watch with five worlds, five bosses and spoken wingman radio calls.
- [Poppy Pop](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821664713): puzzle game for Apple Watch.

## Other apps
- [ARIAemu](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6832322784): emulator for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
- [ARIAemu 3D](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6837978709): N64 and PSP emulator for iPhone and iPad.

## Site
- [Home](https://ariagames.dev/): catalog of games, available in 15 languages.
